name: Swapna Behera

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Swapna Behera is a poet, translator and educator from Odisha whose writing crosses Odia, Hindi and English. Her author website records work in poetry, short fiction and children’s literature, including the English collection “Beyond the Galaxy” and the children’s book “A Bucket of Water on a Bicycle”. It also identifies “The Inner Voice” as her translation of Ved Prakash Sharma’s Hindi poems into English. Education and environmental concerns form part of this wider literary practice.

In “The Ominous Agenda of a Night”, the city’s movement conceals an absence of care. Cars, a railway platform and manufactured smiles surround a woman sheltering beneath a bridge. The poem’s shifting images move from urban exhaustion to the exposed body of someone the city fails to protect. Its night is both a physical setting and a way of asking what ordinary public life chooses not to see.
